'''2000 Alabama State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Birmingham, Alabama, on 29 April 2000. [[Andy McClure]] won it, going 5–1 with a Dark Scum And Villainy ISB deck and a Light Profit deck.

* '''Date:''' 29 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Birmingham, Alabama; Lion and the Unicorn, Birmingham, Alabama<ref name="tr-d627" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy McClure]]
* '''Players:''' 14<ref name="tr-d627" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Rob Ronnlund names his travelling partner Brandon Deakle as finishing 6th at 4–2; the hub (from Andy McClure's report) lists 6th as Barry Dekale, with a question mark.<ref name="tr-d627" />
